model.title: DeOndra Dixon INCLUDE Project Act of 2026
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. John Hickenlooper (D-CO)

summary.text: The bill would require the National Institutes of Health to run a research program on Down syndrome called the INCLUDE Project. The program would cover research on how the condition affects development and health, studies of people with Down syndrome over their lifetimes, expanding clinical trials that include people with Down syndrome, research on biological causes and on conditions that often occur alongside it such as Alzheimer's disease and autoimmunity, and work to improve quality of life for individuals and their families. The bill would also require the agency to coordinate these efforts across its institutes, prioritize research that does not duplicate existing work, consult patient advocates, and submit a report to Congress every two years describing the research carried out.
